one_line: Within a single (target x variant x model) cell, do the 150 seeds that carry the M2 union score have systematically higher per-seed mean payload entropy than the seeds that do not?

explicitly_out_of_scope: any variant other than v1_src and v3_all

m2_definition.meaning: fraction of the frozen hard-branch set hit by the union of the seeds in the scored corpus
m2_definition.filter: struct_hits >= 1 AND rand_hits == 0 (frozen; NOT recomputed by this experiment)

generation_params.note: Values are the repo defaults for codestral-22b (core/config.py); NOT overridden. Generation occurs at the spec-mandated temperature=0.7/top_p=0.95 (research_document_v3.md S5.2).

logprobs.transport: LLMClient.complete(logprobs=True, top_logprobs=20) — additive, env-gated via UTCF_CAPTURE_LOGPROBS
logprobs.cache_safety: logprobs/top_logprobs enter _prompt_hash payload ONLY when non-None; default None => byte-identical key. Guarded by tests/test_llm_client_logprob_backcompat.py.

pool_and_subsampling.S_high: top-150 by per-seed mean payload entropy (descending; deterministic tie-break by seed_id)
pool_and_subsampling.S_low: bottom-150 by per-seed mean payload entropy (ascending; deterministic tie-break by seed_id)
pool_and_subsampling.invariant_4_note: Every SCORED corpus is exactly 150 seeds. The 450 figure is the over-generation POOL only; the 150-seed normalization invariant is preserved at the scoring step.

bootstrap.procedure: see docs/experiment4/METHODS.md (resample 150 seeds with replacement within each subsample, recompute union M2, take percentile 95% CI of the paired difference)

isolation.approach: scripts/run_experiment4_harfbuzz.py — ~40-LOC wrapper instantiating the UNMODIFIED scripts._ablation_base.AblationRunner against dataclasses.replace(TARGETS['harfbuzz'], synthesis_results_root=..., results_root=...)
isolation.m2_fixtures: UNCHANGED — coverage_binary, m2_targets_path, upstream_union_profile_path still point at the real frozen harfbuzz artifacts so M2 is scored against the identical frozen 50-branch set

attempt_offset.rationale: Invariant 5 requires bumping >=5000 on restart to avoid replaying cached failures. Prior offsets seen in docs are <=70000; 600000 is well clear. Also, requesting logprobs changes the cache key vs. experiment2_1's no-logprob entries, so no collision is possible regardless — the offset is belt-and-suspenders + restart-safety.

invariants_honored.9_default_cache_backcompat: default-strategy non-logprob cache key byte-identical; regression-tested

deviations_from_prompt.why: Running the 450-seed pool through run_ablation_harfbuzz.py literally would append-and-subsample into the canonical experiment2_1 codestral-22b harfbuzz v1_src/v3_all seed dirs, destroying experiment2_1's headline cells. The wrapper reuses the UNMODIFIED AblationRunner (all 5 phases + attempt-offset/salt semantics intact) and only redirects output roots. Approved by user 2026-05-17.

deviations_from_prompt.item: Additive logprobs param in core/llm_client.py + generate_ablation_inputs.py
deviations_from_prompt.why: Per-token logprobs cannot be obtained through the existing client path without requesting them. Implemented additively following the established tools/response_format back-compat pattern; default-off and regression-tested for byte-identical cache keys. Approved by user 2026-05-17.
